name: Desideratum
source:
Desideratum is essentially a canonical Anaxverse pulp fiction Visual Novel in Story Mode with RPG elements if playing in Game Mode. It tells the story from the perspectives of a beginner monster hunter and forlorn nosferatu and features dark fantasy, horror, and science fiction.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4323560]Steam[/url]]
